definitions.explanation: The illegal practice of not paying taxes owed by concealing income, falsifying records, or other fraudulent means.

examples.japanese: {脱税|だつぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for tax evasion.

examples.japanese: {脱税|だつぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: Tax evasion is punished as a serious crime.

examples.japanese: {国税庁|こくぜいちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脱税|だつぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}している→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: The National Tax Agency is cracking down on tax evasion.

notes:
{脱税|だつぜい} is a legal term for illegal tax avoidance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱税|だつぜい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to evade taxes
- {脱税|だつぜい}⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧: suspicion of tax evasion
- {脱税|だつぜい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: tax evasion case
- {脱税|だつぜい}⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: amount evaded
- ⟦{悪質|あくしつ}→悪質：20553_akushitsu⟧な{脱税|だつぜい}: malicious tax evasion

CONTRAST WITH LEGAL TAX AVOIDANCE:
- ⟦{節税|せつぜい}→節税：16469_setsuzei⟧: tax savings (legal methods to reduce taxes)
- {脱税|だつぜい}: tax evasion (illegal)
